scope: First improvement-backlog item: scheduling availability only
method: Deterministic greedy constraint checking with human approval; no trained model, LLM or metaheuristic solver

backend_checks.initial_failure: Existing account-workflow test assumed its approved student appeared on the first 10-candidate page. Repeated local fixture runs made that assertion unreliable.
backend_checks.correction: Test gathers every candidate page and checks total, page sizes, unique IDs, approved-student inclusion and non-student exclusion. Admission rules and product behavior were unchanged.
backend_checks.database: Isolated localhost PostgreSQL with a non-superuser, non-BYPASSRLS runtime role
coverage: student/panel positive-window intersection and whole-duration fit
configured working hours, local timezone and DST
numbered-round ordering and immutable reschedule identity
application college filters and independent FORCE RLS reads/writes for both new tables
backend_checks.email_transport: Mocked in account tests; no real inbox-delivery claim

frontend_checks.calendar_checks: Mocked Axios adapter checks all eight wrapper methods/paths, pagination and cancellation versions; server rendering checks date conversion, invalid windows, cancellation history, named calendar explanations and disabled reschedule round identity.

schema.enforcement: Application college_id filters plus PostgreSQL ENABLE/FORCE college_isolation USING and WITH CHECK
schema.migration: Atomic, additive and idempotent; existing bookings gain default round 1 / Interview

local_browser.admin_login_and_calendar_controls: Verified against existing approved local test accounts and PostgreSQL
local_browser.student_availability_controls: Verified own history, cancelled declarations, paging and new panel after student login

limitations: Only recorded calendar facts are checked; administrators must configure institutional hours and required availability.
Active positive windows restrict scheduling until cancelled or replaced, even when outside the search horizon.
Confirmed bookings stay scheduled when calendar rules change; alerts request administrator review.
Round labels organize bookings; they do not automatically pass or select a candidate.
No external calendar sync, holiday import, room-capacity model, panel expertise or globally optimal timetable.
Remaining improvement-backlog items are separate work.
